tool_args.rationale: The long-horizon probe demonstrates the predicted sign reversal and supplies observations at H=8, 16 and 24. Fit the guided sink-coupled dual-exponential law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight observations spanning short and long horizons support fitting the specified five-parameter mechanism; the coupled-lag signature requiring this probe is absent.
The observed long-horizon negative values and short-horizon positive values support temporal reversal rather than a stationary or monotone mechanism.
It does not resolve the mechanism or forecast parameters.
